notes.title: Algebra Ridge - Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Happy birthday to Algebra Ridge! Originally released in November 30... Wait. November 30? We're not even close to November 30! Either I'm too late for the first anniversary, or way ahead of myself for the second... Regardless, Algebra Ridge has finally had it's first major update! What's included? Full controller support, a remade UI and tons, TONS of optimizations and bug fixes!

Here's what you need to know:
- Added full controller support.
- Added a new game over screen for a certain scenario.
- Added an option to enable/disable game's custom cursor.
- Boot time should now be close to instant across most platforms.
- Main menu has received a visual overhaul.
- General dialogue improvements / changes.
- Graphics should look less pixelated with lower resolution screens.
- Updated Shiyoon's design.
- Updated a few backgrounds with a snowy touch.
- Updated a certain crow to look a lot more like a crow instead of a pigeon.
- Reduced overall game size by downscaling unnecessarily large sprites and compressing sounds.
- UI has been improved throughout the game.
	- Card icons have been redrawn.
	- Settings, Results, Upgrade and Exit boxes have been rounded and resized.
	- Main menu is now centered.
- An icon now appears after leaving settings screen, indicating that your settings have been saved.
- The 'F4' key can now be used to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.
- Game will now remember user preferences for window mode.
- Fixed game over screen lagging the game indefinitely.
- Fixed results screen showing up twice upon winning a quiz.

Also this update maayybe makes the game compatible with Steam Deck, but until it gets tested, it's just a theory. An ALGEBRA RIDGE THEORY! Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.0.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
The v1.0.3 hotfix update fixes an issue regarding taking Steam screenshots.

[*] Added missing screenshot feature.
[/list]
Screenshots can now be taken using the Steam Overlay (default key is F12). A .png copy of the screenshot is also saved on the game's save directory.

tags.bug: The v1.0.3 hotfix update fixes an issue regarding taking Steam screenshots.

notes.title: Patch Notes : 1.0.3 (Lunar New Year Update)
notes.content:
New Year? That's cool. Shame it happens only once a year. OR DOES IT? Why celebrate once when you can celebrate TWICE?! That's right, it's Lunar New Year time!

Regardless of when New Year started, here's an update to celebrate Lunar New Year!
This update focuses on polishing the overall Algebra Ridge experience, in order to prepare the game for future updates that will bring new features!

Here are the patch notes for v1.0.3:
[list]
[*] Previously unseen character is now represented in another certain character's sprite.
[*] Changed how the game's sprites are organized, which should help reduce stutters.
[*] Updated a certain broken glass panel in Chapter 1.
[*] Updated a music track that plays in Chapter 5 to better fit it's soundtrack counterpart.
[*] Minor dialogue changes throughout the game.
[*] "Flawless Thinker" achievement now requires a score of at least 7500 instead of 7000 to unlock.
[*] Added the "No Upgrades for You!" achievement.
[*] Added the "Logged Out" achievement.
[*] Added a secret message somewhere in the game.
[*] Fixed issue where music would reset during scene transitions.
[*] Fixed issue when clicking out of the ending screen when paused.
[/list]

Don't forget that the soundtrack is on sale! Now's the time to get your groovy jams on stock!
Get a copy for your grandma! Get a copy for your teacher, so you can TEACH THEM what real education looks like! Get a copy for your pet crow with telekinesis and... Wait, WHAT?
